pages.title: BeesPuzzle
pages.description:
Complete pattern matching by arranging hexagonal tiles featuring intricate bee designs. Rotate and fit each piece to clear rows and score points. The game utilizes spatial puzzle mechanics centered on honeycomb grids, challenging players to optimize placement and pattern completion. Progression advances by increasing complexity and faster tile drops for casual gamers. 

Key Features

• Hexagonal tile rotation  
• Spatial placement mechanics  
• Increasing puzzle complexity  
• Time pressure progression  
• Honeycomb themed grid
